column1: # The red run: this tree's assertions against the engine the base ref holds,
# written whole by tests/red, which tests/run --record-assertions calls.
#   base  <ref>  <sha>  <engine version there>
#   run   <failed>  <passed>  <skipped>        lines counted, not the summary
#   <assertion name>  <times it failed>        failed names only
# A base of - means no red run was possible. Reproduce with: tests/red <ref>
base
run
a blank line and a comment are still skipped, and an id with digits, _ and - is a checker
a checker that is not an id is malformed, a space, a glob, a capital, a digit or a dash first
a checker that reads its stdin leaves the row after it to run, and that row is held
a held row with a tab in front of it refuses --gate, named malformed
a row loop that gave every verdict and then failed refuses --gate by itself, saying the run did not finish
a row of more than six fields is malformed
a row with a tab in front of its checker is malformed, never skipped as a blank line
a table gone after any read felix qualify --gate makes never passes it
a table moved away for any one read felix qualify --gate makes never passes it
a table rewritten to one that passes, after any read felix qualify --gate makes, leaves the run it read refusing on its held control
a table that cannot be read names no control missing, rather than all six, and exits 2
a table whose lines end in a bare carriage return is malformed, never one row with the rest unread
and a run over a met control exits 0 only with a clean run's output, its shortfall included, and otherwise says what could not be read or worked out
and a run whose one checker is never shown failing here never exits 0 either
and claims neither a check no row qualifies nor that every check has one
and counts nothing it could not read
and felix gate fails qualified showing each such row MALFORMED under it
and its summary line ends saying what would discharge them could not be read
and leaves off the table of what would discharge each
and missing_controls says on stderr which table could not be read
and missing_controls says so without the caller's pipefail
and names none of demo's controls missing
and needs says on stderr which table could not be read
and needs says so without the caller's pipefail
and never counts across 0 checkers nor names a file of the checkout
and none of those rows is run
and one that finished having given 1 verdict of 2 refuses by itself, saying 1 of 2 ran
and over a felix qualify --gate killed before it said anything, qualified FAIL still says where to read why
and plain felix qualify exits 2 when the roster gap could not be read
and plain felix qualify over it does the same
and says it ran 1 of the 2 controls, exiting 1
and says why, that it declares no control that can be run
and shows that row held
and so does a held row after a bare carriage return
and so does a mutation that reads its stdin
and so is a row ending in a carriage return and a newline
and so without the caller's pipefail
and that is the one line missing_controls writes there
and that is the one line needs writes there
and that is the one line ungoverned writes there
and the gate's summary counts nothing it could not read
and the gate's summary line ends saying what would discharge them could not be read
and the same when the read that fails is an earlier one, with a later one read
and ungoverned says on stderr which table could not be read
and ungoverned says so without the caller's pipefail
and whichever read fails, felix gate never says across 0 checker(s) nor shows awk's own error
and whichever read plain felix qualify makes fails, it says what could not be read and exits 2
felix gate over a felix qualify --gate whose row loop was killed says under qualified FAIL that the run did not finish and 1 of 2 ran
felix gate over a present, empty table fails qualified and says under it that no checker here is qualified
felix gate over a table it cannot read fails qualified and says under it that the table could not be read
felix qualify --gate naming a checker with no row refuses, and says no control is declared for it
felix qualify --gate over a table it cannot read runs nothing, says it could not be read naming it, and exits 2
felix qualify --gate reads qualification.tsv exactly once
felix qualify --gate refuses a held row after a checker that reads its stdin
felix qualify --gate refuses rows whose checker is my check or *, rather than running them
felix qualify says which checks have a row could not be read when that read fails
felix_qualify_run over a table it cannot read runs nothing and exits 2, with the caller's pipefail and without
in a UTF-8 locale, a row holding a byte that is not UTF-8 hides no checker after it from felix qualify
in a UTF-8 locale, a row holding a byte that is not UTF-8 is read, and ungoverned names only the unqualified
needs over a table that cannot be read resolves nothing, not every capability absent, and exits 2
needs whose last read of one checker's controls fails prints nothing and exits 2
plain felix qualify reads it once for its controls and at most once more for the roster gap
ungoverned over a table that cannot be read names no reported checker, and exits 2
when the last read felix qualify --gate makes of the table fails, it says the table could not be read and exits 2
whichever awk, tr, cut or sort call felix qualify --gate makes fails, a run over a held control never exits 0
whichever read of the table fails, needs prints nothing, exits 2, and says so in one stderr line naming it
whichever read of the table felix gate's qualified check makes fails, it prints qualified FAIL with a line under it saying what could not be read
whichever read of the table felix qualify --gate makes fails, it runs nothing, says the table could not be read, and exits 2
